src-27b939c34a1c59fc.description: Establishes Albuquerque's adopted 2015 bikeway and trail network, policies, design guidance, project priorities, implementation strategies, maintenance practices, and supporting technical material that preceded the current 2024 plan.
processing_notes: Three-hundred-twelve-page May 2015 final plan recovered from the Internet Archive capture recorded in Windows download metadata.
The file is 32,223,817 bytes (30.73 MiB) because it preserves the complete final plan with high-resolution maps, graphics, technical material, and appendices.
No smaller authoritative copy of the complete final was located; the source was preserved without recompression, downsampling, conversion, or splitting.
